artifacts.title: Agent Gym Works
artifacts.description: An IDE for agent scripts: write the lab, the agents and their replies, and watch them work in a top-down floor plan.

artifacts.title: Bench Twin
artifacts.description: A scenario IDE for assembly at the bench: write parts, stage, plan and film, let the timing model schedule people and robots, then cut films or capture labelled sensor views.

artifacts.title: Béton Brut Studio
artifacts.description: A fluent JS grammar that compiles to a graph and renders weathered board-formed brutalist concrete.

artifacts.title: Blockout Studio
artifacts.description: A block-world game engine for Roblox prototyping that grew into a world AI agents build around you.

artifacts.title: Blueprint House
artifacts.description: Procedural Swiss house generator with a coding agent that writes the YAML, CAD plans and elevations, a hairline exploded axonometric, SIA/PBG checks and walkthroughs.

artifacts.title: Blueprint Mech
artifacts.description: A single-file mechanism and CAD drawing IDE: write YAML with parametric sketches, parts, joints and drives, then solve, sweep, drag under constraints, and export ISO drawing sheets as SVG, DXF, STL and CSV.

artifacts.title: Blueprint Physics Kit
artifacts.description: Single-file 2D + 3D blueprint game kit: Jolt/Box2D-style physics with convex hulls (GJK/EPA), terrain, bullets, character controller, ragdolls and rewind, plus a YAML scene language and built-in docs.

artifacts.title: Brand Crystal
artifacts.description: A five-step studio to explore, define, refine, test and understand a brand language, ending in a living guide.

artifacts.title: Brickwork
artifacts.description: A workbench for brick models written as code: a JavaScript program compiles into a 3D model with build steps, a parts bag, rule checks and an LDraw export.

artifacts.title: Claude.Computer
artifacts.description: A computer you and Claude share, one per conversation: Claude answers by building files and small apps on a desktop you both use, live.

artifacts.title: CraftKit Studio
artifacts.description: A photo and print studio in the browser: cull, develop, export, soft-proof and print zines, riso and screenprints, with a develop engine compiled to WebAssembly.

artifacts.title: CraftKit Workbench
artifacts.description: One JavaScript grammar over real photo, vector, type, sheet, CAD and sound engines compiled to wasm, with 138 examples from halftones and riso prints to posters, plotter maps and drum loops.

artifacts.title: Derived, Not Fixed
artifacts.description: A living provocation: say what you want and a cloud of intents condenses into a working interface, followed by the vocabulary of math and fourteen experiences in seven theses, all drawn from one shader with no components.

artifacts.title: Diary Workbench
artifacts.description: Read coding-agent diaries next to an inventory of the code they built, write views over them in JavaScript, and test those views on databases made to break them; the bundled example is the public go-go-golems/geppetto repository with its 167 implementation diaries.

artifacts.title: Dockermetrics IDE
artifacts.description: An IDE for a composable JavaScript grammar over Docker metrics: query, stream, alert and build dashboards against a simulated container fleet that runs in the browser.

artifacts.title: DS Shader Sketchbook
artifacts.description: A notebook of twelve live GLSL sketches for a dual-screen handheld, each with its shader, its JS and the device API that would ship it.

artifacts.title: Exposure Studio
artifacts.description: A world-building language where cameras invent what they see and rules decide what becomes real.

artifacts.title: Fluchtlinie
artifacts.description: An endless first-person parkour run across a procedural city in an anime ink style.

artifacts.title: Form Skate Workbench
artifacts.description: An IDE and agent for building a skateboard game from the ground up: editable physics, motors, trick recognition and a drafting-sheet stage.

artifacts.title: Fringe Studio
artifacts.description: Interference design tool: place wave emitters, shape the complex field, roll seeded variations, and read how the math works.

artifacts.title: Graveler Lab
artifacts.description: A lab for lakeFS's Graveler: write an experiment in YAML and watch every commit drawn as SSTable ranges over the keyspace, rewritten or shared.

artifacts.title: HALO Field
artifacts.description: Program augmented-reality overlays for the shop floor: point a phone at machine, part and work-order markers and float gauges, trends, datasheets, 3D models and checklists on them.

artifacts.title: Hypercore Studio
artifacts.description: The Living Comic engine in deep space: grow monsters from code and stage sci-fi comic pages under a magenta nebula.

artifacts.title: Kiln Studio
artifacts.description: An IDE for LLM post-training programs: write SFT, DPO and RL pipelines in JavaScript, see them as a graph, catch leaks, watch a simulated run, and export code for Unsloth, TRL, prime-rl, verl or PyTorch.

artifacts.title: Kiln Workbench
artifacts.description: A compiler workbench: write passes and IRs in JavaScript, watch every rewrite, generate CUDA and WGSL, and measure kernels on simulated GPUs.

artifacts.title: Kinescope
artifacts.description: Kinescope is a presentation editor that draws every slide, transition and effect with GPU shaders (WebGPU, falling back to WebGL), so each slide re-lays itself out for any screen shape, from a wide display to a phone.

artifacts.title: Küstenlinie
artifacts.description: A drive down the real Big Sur stretch of Highway 1 on live California time, in a black cabriolet, with an endless autopilot cruise and a mixable desert-house and ASMR coast soundtrack.

artifacts.title: Lab 104 · Factory Twin
artifacts.description: Write a whole factory in JavaScript and watch it play as a technical drawing, with live fisheye and thermal cameras, coverage and blind spots, and an agent that edits the scene.

artifacts.title: Lantern Slide Studio
artifacts.description: A slide studio where the deck is a JavaScript script, every slide is a GLSL shader that gets its words as a texture, and every transition is a shader too.

artifacts.title: Lastwork Foundry
artifacts.description: A self-contained BW sneaker foundry: a YAML language builds foot → last → sole → foam → flat-knitted upper, simulates stance and flex, and collapses endless new designs and knit programs with wave-function solvers.

artifacts.title: Lattice Arcade
artifacts.description: Twelve game screens drawn entirely in shaders for a two-screen handheld, from a Mode 7 world map to a shattering pause menu, each one playable on a single scrolling page.

artifacts.title: Lattice Arena
artifacts.description: A programmable arena for LLM robots: script boards and agents in JavaScript, then watch them plan and drive across a three.js 3D floor, with hooks, forks, rubric scoring and a GEPA-style prompt optimiser.

artifacts.title: Lattice Arena DS
artifacts.description: Lattice Arena on a dual-screen handheld: the same programmable arena for LLM robots, watched on a top screen and driven from a touch screen with a D-pad, face buttons, Select and Start.

artifacts.title: Lattice Deck
artifacts.description: A programmable presentation and live graphics workbench with scripted agents, hosted model access and collaboration rooms.

artifacts.title: Lattice Phantasmagoria
artifacts.description: A playable dual-screen canvas and WebGL experiment with cartridges and scenes. Browser-only proof of concept.

artifacts.title: Lattice Rift
artifacts.description: An interactive WebGL instrument for melting, tearing and mending a lattice. Browser-only proof of concept.

artifacts.title: Lie Group IK Playground
artifacts.description: Drag a target and watch a robot arm solve inverse kinematics on SE(2) or SE(3): damped least-squares steps in the tangent space, mapped back with Exp, with geodesics, residuals and the ways it breaks.

artifacts.title: Live Embedding Viewer
artifacts.description: Watch a stream of video embeddings live: a running t-SNE map with clusters, text-query lanes, a zero-shot classifier, semantic axes, self-similarity and novelty.

artifacts.title: Living Comic Studio
artifacts.description: Write a comic as a program: 3D actors, cameras, balloons and inks, staged into living pages, plus a chat room where messages become panels.

artifacts.title: Loom Brawl
artifacts.description: A fighting-move studio where YAML scripts drive the Loom mannequin, plus a 40-second teaser.

artifacts.title: Loom City
artifacts.description: A top-down micro city where traffic, crowds, crime and police produce unscripted stories you can scrub and branch.

artifacts.title: Loom Hours
artifacts.description: A procedural lofi room in Loom's drafting style: a resident and her cat follow composable routines under your real local sky, to a generative beat.

artifacts.title: Loom: humanoids in the factory
artifacts.description: A YAML language for programming humanoid factory work, plus a marionette studio driven by your body.

artifacts.title: Loom Pitch
artifacts.description: write football tactics for both teams as chained JavaScript, compiled to a graph and played out live by 3D players, with an agent that edits and tests the code for you.

artifacts.title: Loom Playtime
artifacts.description: An endless procedural animation of a hairline marionette playing with a robot pup, with a live code editor, a live math panel and a hidden studio, all in one file.

artifacts.title: Loom Wilds
artifacts.description: A 3D physics and chemistry sandbox after Breath of the Wild's multiplicative play.

artifacts.title: Loom Worlds
artifacts.description: One saloon loop on one floor plan, reskinned as nine period-correct worlds.

artifacts.title: lowpoly/fx
artifacts.description: A particle system designer with a pixel-art stage: script emitters, forces and looks, drive them with sliders and modulators, and see the IR graph and generated kernels.

artifacts.title: Lumen Studio
artifacts.description: WebGPU path tracer in a single HTML file, where you write photorealistic scenes in a fluent JavaScript grammar.

artifacts.title: Machine Zone
artifacts.description: A procedural video engine for loud, beat-synced hypnotic loops built from slot-machine and feed tricks.

artifacts.title: Metropolis
artifacts.description: Townforge ported to the Facet engine: build a Fritz Lang Metropolis in Art Deco hairlines, with WFC facades, skybridges, a Tower of Babel, a timelapse, and a Mathematics tab explaining every algorithm.

artifacts.title: Millwright
artifacts.description: A compiler for robot choreography: compose arm, gantry, legged, AMR and humanoid motions as clips with signals and shared resources, and watch them scheduled in 3D.

artifacts.title: Mimeo
artifacts.description: A zine workbench: write pages as a script, with exact-odds tables, picture recipes, clay creatures and print-ready spreads.

artifacts.title: Mimeo Studio
artifacts.description: Mimeo with tools that know the rules: a canvas editor for script-made zines, where the script decides how things turn, snap, scale and layer, and refused edits say why.

artifacts.title: Mossbloom
artifacts.description: A cozy island village where villager agents garden, build and gossip on their own while you sow and brief them.

artifacts.title: Mossbrook
artifacts.description: An Age of Empires 2-style pixel RTS on a Townscaper-like organic grid with live water, fire and seasons.

artifacts.title: Nerve Workbench
artifacts.description: A workbench for combinatorial topology: Sperner's lemma, nerves, homology and persistence written as short programs, drawn live with the theory beside them.

artifacts.title: No DOM: the interface is a projection
artifacts.description: From globe-to-map projections to the idea that every interface is a projection of one state.

artifacts.title: no_shade
artifacts.description: A simpler, canvas-first rework of no_shade: Figma for shader-based websites (v21, Arial A–Z).

artifacts.title: Note G
artifacts.description: A marker-sketched Analytical Engine, after Babbage's 1840 plan, that runs Ada Lovelace's Note G in five sub-steps per card, with live detail close-ups, turning figure wheels and card chains.

artifacts.title: Octavo IDE
artifacts.description: An IDE for mathematics chapters on a two-screen handheld: write cards in Markdown and TeX, script verbs and flows, and read, peek, map and practise on the device beside the editor.

artifacts.title: Octavo Lab
artifacts.description: An operating-system playground: worlds in QuickJS sandboxes on a virtual dual-screen handheld, with faults, timelines and a coding agent.

artifacts.title: on_twos
artifacts.description: A black-and-white studio for procedural Spider-Verse-style loops with video, GIF, PNG and HTML export.

artifacts.title: Overshoot
artifacts.description: Script-driven CAD that draws products as marker, ballpoint, ink or painted concept sketches.

artifacts.title: Patent Drawer
artifacts.description: Describe an invention and get USPTO-style patent drawings, plus a Foundry that generates and ranks a thousand.

artifacts.title: Plads
artifacts.description: A playful scriptable canvas, expanded by distilling ideas from 30 creative-coding libraries.

artifacts.title: Plenum Studio
artifacts.description: An IDE for websites built as maps: a fluent JS grammar compiled to an IR and DAG, a WebGL field renderer, nine presets and Claude agents.

artifacts.title: Pointfield CAD
artifacts.description: Implicit CAD in the browser: a fluent JavaScript grammar compiles to an IR DAG and GLSL; organic primitives, a measuring agent loop and a timelapse recorder.

artifacts.title: Polis
artifacts.description: Shared-room agent workspace

artifacts.title: Porous Forge
artifacts.description: A fluent grammar for exact 3D-printable parts and simulated ESP32 devices.

artifacts.title: Port Wright
artifacts.description: Lightweight Procedural Port Simulation

artifacts.title: Possie Toybox
artifacts.description: A procedural plush toy that agents possess through a YAML door: lease, safety gate, signed record, simulated agents on autoplay, and a blind-box factory.

artifacts.title: Pre-Textile Atelier
artifacts.description: A CLO-style print studio where YAML cuts the garment itself (necklines, sleeves, hems, flare, tote and hat shapes) and prints on it, draped live in 3D, with a generated Lookbook and a chiptune trailer.

artifacts.title: RAG Workbench
artifacts.description: An editable retrieval pipeline with public sample documentation, Markdown uploads, lexical search and hosted model access.

artifacts.title: Roomba Rooms
artifacts.description: A roomba cleans an endless chain of procedurally generated rooms. Watch its live WebGL view beside a top-down map, in a single file with no dependencies.

artifacts.title: Shop
artifacts.description: Shop is a design canvas built on code, where you and AI agents design side by side and every edit stays real, reviewable code.

artifacts.title: Shop Next
artifacts.description: “A design canvas where the design is the running product: screens, people, data, services and tests on one stage, shaped with Claude and published as an app people actually use.

artifacts.title: Shop Strata
artifacts.description: A canvas where design grows like a colony, with a large Alpstein example: 27 screens, 6 data tables and three weeks of growth that runs as an app.

artifacts.title: Slopster
artifacts.description: A procedurally animated cartoon lobster that runs its own routine forever in an axonometric, aquascaped 90 cm tank, with live field notes on its joints, gait, swimmerets, sense of smell and the space it lives in.

artifacts.title: SO(3) Playground
artifacts.description: An interactive guide to the rotation group: turn an airplane from a ball of rotation vectors, compare geodesics with straight lines, watch composition depart from addition, and check Jacobians against the exact perturbation.

artifacts.title: Sonnet New Roman Modular
artifacts.description: A type studio where a variable serif is a script: edit Sonnet New Roman's 178 glyphs and three axes, check and animate it, compile a TTF, and let Claude keep drawing it.

artifacts.title: Splice Console
artifacts.description: A two-slot console that weaves any pair of YAML cartridges into one new 1-bit game.

artifacts.title: StackChan Pet Studio
artifacts.description: A studio for giving a Stack-chan desk robot a pet's personality: script looks, moods, reactions, dances, lights and chirps, and watch the robot act them out in 3D.

artifacts.title: Stamen Studio
artifacts.description: A live-coding studio for ink-drawn 3D worlds: compose deserts, swamps, meadows and hives from one grammar of shapes and tune them with sliders that rewrite the script.

artifacts.title: Station Point
artifacts.description: Station Point: a YAML-driven perspective-drawing CAD tool; adds FOLD, an original clamshell console sheet in pencil + one blue marker.

artifacts.title: Tabula Workbench
artifacts.description: A programmable reactive workbook with live inputs, charts and model-assisted editing. Workbook drafts live in this browser.

artifacts.title: Takt
artifacts.description: Rethinking the notebook

artifacts.title: Takt Workbench
artifacts.description: Script a workstation and its operators in JavaScript, then watch the plan run in 3D with a two-handed timeline of every gesture.

artifacts.title: Thought Machines
artifacts.description: Whiteboard tools are good at capturing thoughts; diagram languages like Mermaid are good at structure. Neither lets a diagram do anything

artifacts.title: Tilth Garden
artifacts.description: A bot gym: developer agents and their bots tend one shared garden through seasons, droughts and blight, and you edit their JavaScript while it runs.

artifacts.title: Tinker
artifacts.description: A procedural robot that grew into an animation studio and then a cute backrooms shooter.

artifacts.title: Transcript Hub
artifacts.description: A shared hub for Claude Code transcripts: upload sessions, read them turn by turn, annotate as a team and query them from JavaScript.

artifacts.title: Twin Motion IDE
artifacts.description: Script films and presentations over a factory twin: shots, camera paths, transitions and overlays on an editable timeline, rendered to WebM.

artifacts.title: Twin Render Playground
artifacts.description: The ink renderer behind the factory twins on its own: build a room from the asset library and tune looks, buffers, cameras, coverage, paths and callouts live.

artifacts.title: Type Studio
artifacts.description: Parametric variable-font studio: YAML DSL, JS API, live glyph editor, lint and OpenType compiler in one file.

artifacts.title: Uncommon Math
artifacts.description: An interactive book on the mathematics behind 195 unusual web demos, with 25 chapters, 113 runnable sketches and a map of every demo.

artifacts.title: Vigil
artifacts.description: A playable attention-driven idle game on an abstract dot-field planet, with its full design document and live demos of every procedural animation technique.

artifacts.title: Visiting Hours
artifacts.description: A playable prototype of a whitelisted daycare for agents: a cube-sphere playground with disc physics, tile chemistry, eight guests who act only through YAML, a seven-layer gate and a hashed record.

artifacts.title: Vitrine
artifacts.description: Vitrine generates looping ink-and-Copic dioramas from a few lines of YAML and uses wave function collapse to grow them into whole worlds, while Claude keeps inventing new pieces to build with.

artifacts.title: Weft
artifacts.description: A shader language whose pixels are glyphs, and whose fields can be read by text, physics, particles and terminal widgets.

artifacts.title: Wend
artifacts.description: A minimal ambient ride on a gravel bike through a seeded pencil-drawn world; one orbiting pinhole camera, colours that return as you gather glyphs, and a Math view that shows every formula live.

artifacts.title: Wildforge
artifacts.description: A planet god-game: shape land, water and life on a living globe, now with switchable art looks.

artifacts.title: Xenoform Studio
artifacts.description: A specimen studio: write alien creatures as code from bodies, tentacles, limbs and eyes, and watch them move in a live 3D scene drawn in eighteen ink and print looks.
